name: Shiv Nadar University Chennai
summary: Shiv Nadar University Chennai was established under the Shiv Nadar University Act 2018 of the Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly — the state's first private university. Its campus on Rajiv Gandhi Salai (OMR) at Kalavakkam has four schools: Engineering, Commerce & Management, the Shiv Nadar School of Law, and Science & Humanities. Undergraduates are admitted through its own entrance exam, SNUCEE, or (for B.Tech) a JEE Main score.

testing.test: SNUCEE (Shiv Nadar University Chennai Entrance Exam)
testing.notes: B.Tech may instead be admitted on a JEE Main score.

internationalTuition.notes: Foreign national / OCI / PIO, per year. NRI: ₹4,50,000–5,25,000.

domesticTuition.notes: Per year for Indian nationals: ₹3,50,000 for computing and electronics B.Tech branches; ₹3,00,000 for other B.Tech branches, B.Com and B.Sc Economics.
